book: Four-book collection of David Pareus's Latin school exercises and orations (Heidelberg, 1610): a dedication to Gryn, then Liber I (philosophical exercises), Liber II (theological exercises), Liber III (longer theological declamations) and Liber IV (thirteen anniversary orations), each book a numbered series.
